ORDINANCE



 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO :

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the 81-3,
Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-2, Community Shopping District; and B3-3,
Community Shopping District; symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-C in the
area bound by:

        South Constance Avenue; a line 200 feet north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the
       alley next east of and parallel to South Jeffery Boulevard; a line 98.25 feet north of and
       parallel to East 71 st Street; South Chappel Avenue; a line 76.6 feet north of and parallel
       to East 71 st Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Chappel Avenue; a line
        148.75 feet north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Clyde Avenue; the alley next
       north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Merrill Avenue; East 71 st Street; a line
       115.5 feet east of and parallel to South Jeffery Boulevard; the alley next south of and
       parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley nex t east of and parallel to South Euclid Avenue; a
       line 110 feet south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; a line 112 feet south of and parallel
       to East 71 st Street; South Euclid Avenue; a line 192.94 feet south of and parallel to East
       71 st Street; a line 134.45 feet west of and parallel to South Euclid Avenue; a line 304 feet
       south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Bennet Avenue; and East 71 st Street.

to those of a 83-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
